fc.digest.name: Situation digest
fc.digest.purpose: Every reply carries a short digest of nearby events, people, custom names, carried items and check results
fc.digest.more: The core link between the map and the model; always on and suits every card. It costs about 100–300 tokens per reply. Here you can only see what it sent.
fc.state.name: Status line
fc.state.purpose: One line before each reply: place, people present, time, trips
fc.state.more: Suits cards whose prompt does not state the place; fields the card prompt already shows are skipped; over the budget, trips go first, then people.
fc.state.cost: About 40–150 tokens per reply, the limit is yours
fc.macros.name: Macros
fc.macros.purpose: {{eden_here}}, {{eden_route}} and {{eden_fly …}} for card and preset authors
fc.macros.more: Does nothing unless a prompt uses them; for authors who place the map's facts in their own prompt.
fc.dice.name: Dice checks
fc.dice.purpose: Searches and stealth roll for real: a failure fails and is reported; off = hints only
fc.dice.more: Suits cards with exploration and risk; a failed check is told to the model as a fact, so the story follows it.
fc.ledger.name: Settlement records
fc.ledger.purpose: Record people's places from the schedule and events from the chat into the map's own chat variable, filling gaps only
fc.ledger.more: Never writes the card's variables; useful when the card's own variables are sparse.
fc.spatial.name: Spatial contract
fc.spatial.purpose: A short coordinate JSON (current place, exits, nearby landmarks) instead of direction prose
fc.spatial.more: Helps models keep directions consistent; about 120 tokens per reply.
fc.wbJit.name: Worldbook JIT
fc.wbJit.purpose: Only the add-on worldbook entries of where you are (and its neighbours) are enabled; leaving disables them
fc.wbJit.more: Saves context on large worlds; touches only entries of our own add-on book.
fc.wbXtal.name: Fact crystallisation
fc.wbXtal.purpose: Fact tags in replies become keyword entries of the add-on book
fc.wbXtal.more: Suits long campaigns; a fact you delete in the book never comes back.
fc.nav.name: AI advisor
fc.nav.purpose: In the background, your own API endpoint suggests clues, marks, events and routes on the map
fc.nav.more: Costs your own tokens; never writes to the chat; suggestions are shown for this session only.
fc.nav.cost: Costs your own tokens, see the count for each interval below
fc.inject.name: Map actions into chat
fc.inject.purpose: Card buttons put a sentence into the chat input (or as a system note)
fc.inject.more: Fill input never sends; the system note goes through /sys.
fc.nav.model: Model (the default is editable; type any model id)
fc.nav.test_cost: A test sends one tiny request and costs a few tokens
fc.nav.consent: The AI advisor calls your own API in the background to suggest things on the map; requests go only to the endpoint you enter and use your quota.
fc.nav.agree_why: Test the connection first: you can agree once it passes
fc.nav.cad_120000: Every 2 min ≈ 30 small requests an hour
fc.nav.cad_300000: Every 5 min ≈ 12 small requests an hour
fc.nav.cad_600000: Every 10 min ≈ 6 small requests an hour
